A1 is below the axis and nearly vertically beneath B1; a short downward shaft joins the B1 base to the A1 region.

A line from K extends left near-horizontally through the A1 region and carries a leftward arrowhead.
A shallower oblique line joins the P/A1 region and extends left/downward with a leftward arrowhead.
The descending steep line passes through the O/A1 region toward the lower mirror and carries a down-right arrowhead near its lower-right portion.
sourceFigureInventory.relationshipPrecision: Visual incidence and ordering only. No numeric coordinates, mathematical solution, semantic ray classification or exact collinearity proof is granted.
